title: ieee80211-radio: Add EHT Data rate computation
description:
Add MCS Rate table for EHT.
Only rates for 1 Spatial Stream is added, higher spatial stream data
rates are computed based on 1ss rate (upto +/- 0.5Mbps error expected
from corresponding MCS Rate table values at https://mcsindex.net)

Also add peekremote and radiotap changes required to extract bandwidth, # of spatial
streams, mcs rate and guard interval from EHT field and USIG field.
Closes: #19848
